name: Connie Amarance
source:
This is the tale of Connie Amarance, a woman who has lost everyone she loves -- her friends, her family, and her fiancé -- and has been left all alone. The story of a woman's internal struggle that leads her to see the world through her younger self, and deal with the enchantment and consequences of those who her heart now touches.

[Edited from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hecHph1fNqY]Sekai Project[/url]]
translation:
这是康妮·阿玛兰丝的故事。她失去了所有所爱之人——朋友、家人和未婚夫——如今孤身一人。这是关于一名女性内心斗争的故事，她将通过年幼时的自己看待世界，并面对如今被内心触碰之人带来的魔法与后果。

[改编自[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hecHph1fNqY]Sekai Project[/url]]
